text: {"verdict": "refuted", "answer": "The corpus evidence describes the opposite causal direction: nicotine-driven degradation of MKP1 induces p38 MAPK (and JNK) activation, which increases IRS1 serine-307 phosphorylation, impairs insulin-mediated suppression of lipolysis, and thereby elevates lipolysis.
